description: This file provides a Python interface to Amazon MWS APIs, including classes for various API sections such as Feeds, Reports, Orders, Products, Sellers, Recommendations, Finances, and Inventory. It includes utility functions for request signing, MD5 calculation, and XML namespace removal, and defines custom exceptions.

classes.name: MWSError
classes.description: Main exception class for Amazon MWS errors.

classes.name: DictWrapper
classes.description: Wraps XML data into a dictionary, removing namespaces.

classes.name: DataWrapper
classes.description: Validates and wraps raw data, especially for MD5 hash verification.

classes.name: MWS
classes.description: Base class for Amazon MWS API interactions, handles request signing and execution.

methods.name: calc_md5
methods.description: Calculates the base64-encoded MD5 hash of a string.

methods.name: remove_empty
methods.description: Removes keys with empty values from a dictionary.

methods.name: remove_namespace
methods.description: Removes XML namespace declarations from an XML string.

methods.name: get_timestamp
methods.description: Returns current timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

methods.name: enumerate_param
methods.description: Builds a dictionary of enumerated parameters for API requests.
